title: METR Task Horizon Growth
description: Interactive visualization of AI task completion capabilities from 2019-2030, showing the 7-month doubling time discovered by METR research.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Explain the METR task-horizon metric: the duration of a human task an AI system can complete with 50% probability of success
Interpret the 7-month doubling time from data points spanning GPT-2 (2.4 minutes, 2019) to GPT-5 (137 hours, 2025)
Compare the linear and logarithmic scale views to explain why exponential growth appears as a straight line on a log axis
Predict task-horizon values through 2030 using the projection toggle and evaluate the assumptions behind extrapolating the trend
